handler_preflight.method: Fresh daemon-host read-only /proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc bind through a pinned, owner-labeled disposable Docker helper; exact owner, ID, image, no-network, no-privilege, read-only root and mounts checked. Helper and image-declared anonymous volume removed by exact ID and independently read back absent before return. The same preflight runs before new MIPS build and target smoke. No host handler mutation.

limitations: The offline verifier requires its Docker-local locked image; the archived image may be explicitly loaded from the pinned cache without network when the daemon image store is empty. HTTPS smoke runs from the Hermes host namespace because locked target BusyBox wget lacks TLS, not from the target namespace.
